title: Winey Chewy Syrian Meat Tagine
description: Comforting Syrian dish featuring red wine jelly, yuzu-cure, and tender meat, perfect for a cold winter night.

ingredients.name: Yuzu juice
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use fresh yuzu for best flavor.

ingredients.name: Brown sugar
ingredients.notes: Replace with honey for a more natural sweetener.

instructions: Heat ghee or oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear the short ribs until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the short ribs and set aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until it's softened and lightly browned, about 8-10 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beef broth, cumin seeds, cardamom, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine, then add the brown sugar and red wine jelly to the pot.
Return the short ribs to the pot and make sure they're coated with the sauce.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven. Braise for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the meat is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let the short ribs rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Strain the sauce and discard any excess fat.
Skim the sauce with a spoon to remove any air bubbles.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with parsley, lemon wedges, yuzu-cured olives, and cilantro or parsley.
Serve immediately, spooning the sauce over the short ribs.
Garnish with additional parsley or cilantro if desired.
